thread:
maya: FYI a new user hit a 402 on first quickstart call. They followed README exactly and got `Error: Request failed with status code 402`.

devon: That's usually a billing gate. Is the workspace marked billing_required?

maya: Yes server log: {status:402, error:"billing_required", request_id:"req_zz12"}. The client only retried once and showed a generic axios error.

samir: Two small fixes: 1) JS SDK should treat 402 as a non-retriable onboarding error with a help_url to the org billing page; 2) sample Next server should warn when `x-workspace-id` header is missing (common with dev proxies like Vercel).

onboard-bot: Suggested DM: "It looks like your workspace needs billing setup. See https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/billing"

devon: Assigning: SDK PR (samir, 2d), sample warning & README note (maya, 1d).
